newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain after initial fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain after initial fall.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery recovered at lower levels to 1,170/1,171 rupees on Monday after initially falling to 1,163/1,164 rupees, dealers said.

Daily new crop arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region rose to 20-25,000 bags (75 kg each). Groundnut oil remained steady at 342/344 rupees per 10 kg amid poor physical enquiries and restricted arrivals of 60/80 tonnes.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
"The undercurrent of the market however remained subdued on news of arrivals of about 5,000-5,500 tonnes of imported palm oil at Bombay port," one miller said.
